## Old query and replacement
- **Old:** `@container (min-width: 720px) { .shell__body { … } }`. It was an unnamed container query, which resolves to the nearest ancestor container, here `.shell` with `container-type: inline-size`. The old threshold was already 720px, so the value is unchanged.
- **New:** `@media (min-width: 720px) { .shell__body { … } }`, with the same declarations inside.
- **Removed:** `.shell { container-type: inline-size; }`. I searched the whole repo for `@container`, `container-type`, `container-name` and `container:`. Nothing else queries that container, and `.shell` had no `container-name`. The rule would have been empty, so I deleted it entirely.

`src/layout/PRECEDENT.md` has no rules about how overrides must be recorded. I followed its existing format: `### §id — title` headings with `Since`, `Decision`, `Forbidden` and `Reason` fields.
